breve: A physics joint that attaches two 2D physics bodies at a single point, allowing them to freely rotate.
descricao: A physics joint that attaches two 2D physics bodies at a single point, allowing them to freely rotate. For example, a RigidBody2D can be attached to a StaticBody2D to create a pendulum or a seesaw.
